findings.summary: Training's stated exit — "a worker passes the quiz" — names a step no shipped screen offers
findings.detail: pages/admin/training-courses.vue is the only Training page in the app: there is no worker-facing surface at all, and none is planned for this wave. `utils/training/training-client.js` records that a worker's own quiz submission has no route anywhere, so every completion is `ManagerRecorded` by construction; `TrainingVersionPanel` authors no quiz for the same reason and prints the sentence asserted above. What this journey walks is therefore the MANAGER half — a score filed against a frozen threshold — which is the whole of what exists. The Feature's exit and L-TRAIN-FIXES's exit both name the worker half and neither can be met by any screen on this branch.

findings.summary: the admin shell logs a router «Navigation cancelled» pair on every signed-in journey
findings.detail: Seen 2 times here and identically in growth-privacy-queue, workforce-flag-lever and workforce-schedule-publish. It is AdminPage's login redirect being superseded by the storeId append, not anything on this page. Recorded so it is not re-diagnosed from here.
